sourceFile: 37.MSU-20S15-07 Result checking final SPK lot 50k NG separate VP+CD_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the report topic and result rows, but the changed-factor framing is incorrect and cannot be final evidence.
issues: Baseline/test comparison is invented; report is a recheck/validation of a VP+CD separate NG lot.
Date and 2nd/3rd rounds are misclassified as changed conditions.
Subgroup keys mix line, model, and round without preserving them clearly.
Function results and VP+CD separate NG-sample results are merged under one vague metric header.
Decision row is identified but not cited in outcomes.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to the rechecked final SPK lot 50K NG separate VP+CD condition.
Remove explicit baseline/test comparison unless source rows prove one.
Treat 1st/2nd/3rd as test-round subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Separate function-check outcomes from VP+CD separate NG-sample outcomes.
Add the decision row citation and use it only if its text is available.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until corrected.
